hypothesis: H-d: disclosure TEXT CONTENT (annual-report MD&A tone/uncertainty/complexity), LLM-scored, predicts forward 12M excess return. Power-insufficient pilot.
novelty_axis: material — raw disclosure TEXT (distinct from WT-D20260710_005 which killed disclosure METADATA = size-proxy confound)
metric_type: pilot_rank_correlation (NOT canonical_screen, NOT backtested). Screening-tier research triage only.
blind_discipline: scores frozen to disk BEFORE any return access; scoring read excerpts-only file

sample.design: stratified 3 cap_tier x 3 year_bin = 9 cells x 5 (balanced 5/cell realized)
sample.universe: KOSPI200 UNION KOSDAQ150 (rawdata K200|KQ150), Size>0 at (fiscal_year+1)-03 snapshot
sample.source: DART document.xml, annual business report (사업보고서), MD&A section '경영진단 및 분석의견'

pit.fwd_window: 12 months starting the month AFTER the rcept month (no overlap with pre-disclosure period)
pit.returns: monthly compounded (daily Ret clipped to KR price-limit +-0.35 for error hygiene), excess = stock - KOSPI200 TR (BM_Ret) same window

results_vs_fwd12m_excess_primary.note: Spearman rho, bootstrap 90% CI (2000 reps), permutation p (20000), full N=45

size_confound_control.note: WT-005 lesson: verify TEXT signal is not a size proxy

complexity.conclusion: complexity is NOT a size proxy; survives Size control

tone.note: tone mildly size-correlated; reverse signal weakens but persists

complexity_robustness.conclusion: negative in every tier and every vintage; not a size/time artifact; no single obs drives it

n_trials.multiple_testing: complexity uncorrected p=0.035; Bonferroni x4 -> ~0.14 (not significant). Pilot waived MT gate per prereg.

verdict_tier: weak-tier / screening-tier research lead (NOT capital-grade, NOT an admitted alpha)
verdict_basis: Pre-registered rule met by COMPLEXITY axis: 90% CI excludes 0 (-0.506,-0.100), sign matches hypothesis (negative/obfuscation), survives Size control (partial -0.313, CI excl 0, cor with logSize ~0). Robust across tiers/vintages/jackknife. Secondary: tone hypothesis REJECTED in sign but reverse-tone (overoptimism penalty) is a lead (p=0.13).
verdict_caveats: IC->PORT_t transition wall: rank correlation is NOT realized long-only portfolio-alpha t. No canonical PORT_t claim (prereg forbade).
Scorer = the agent (subjective complexity); mechanism (obfuscation vs disclosure-type proxy) unresolved at pilot power.
n=45 underpowered; would not survive strict multiple-testing correction.

scale_up_design.objective: Confirm complexity->return with objective readability + establish PORT_t transition on a monthly-rebalanced canonical screen

phase_A_full_panel_objective.what: Compute OBJECTIVE readability (mean sentence length, Fog-equivalent, table-density, nominalization rate) on ALL K200uKQ150 annual-report MD&A, fiscal 2010-2023 (~3000-4000 filings). Free (DART API + R text parsing, no LLM).
phase_A_full_panel_objective.cost: compute-only; ~1.5s/doc fetch x ~3500 = ~1.5h fetch + R parse; $0 external
phase_A_full_panel_objective.test: monthly cross-sectional Spearman IC time-series -> ICIR + Newey-West Harvey-t; then canonical_screen_bt(complexity-sorted top-N EW long-only) -> portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 vs 2.95 gate
phase_A_full_panel_objective.power: full-panel; enables the capital-grade gate the pilot cannot reach

phase_B_llm_tone_uncertainty.what: LLM tone/uncertainty on a powered subset (~300) to validate the reverse-tone lead (flip sign: optimism -> lower return)

sample_size_power.rationale: observed rho ~0.30 is winner's-curse inflated; power to a conservative true rho=0.20 under multiple-testing correction -> ~275-300

phase_B_llm_tone_uncertainty.cost: agent in-context scoring ~300 docs x ~1000 tok excerpt ~= 0.3M input tokens; no external API (compute-only). Prefer objective metrics where possible.

scale_up_design.recommended_route: Phase A first (free, full-power, reaches PORT_t gate). Only if complexity survives canonical PORT_t, run Phase B LLM tone as an orthogonal overlay feature.

universe_comparison.note: L-227 universe v2 mandate applies to ICIR-attenuation diagnosis on canonical screens. This pilot is a rank-correlation triage (not a canonical screen), so v2 KR_TOP500_FREEFLOAT comparison is deferred to Phase A scale-up (where canonical_screen_bt runs). cost_model_version input = v2.4_kr_retail_15bps (request.json), consistent with default KR_top342-class universe.

screen_route: TEXT_READABILITY_FEATURE -> Phase A objective-readability full-panel canonical screen (not DPL_FEATURE, discontinued v8.3)
